source:

app.use(incompatible)

name: case-union-writer
source: const writer: GravitoMiddleware<{ user: string | number }> = async (c, next) => { c.set('user', 123); await next() }; app.use(writer)

source: const writer: GravitoMiddleware<{ user: string | number }> = async (c, next) => { c.set('user', 123); await next() }; app.get('/', writer)

source: const writer: GravitoMiddleware<{ user: string | number }> = async (c, next) => { c.set('user', 123); await next() }; app.router.add('get', '/', [writer])

name: case-rate-callback
source: import { rateLimit } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/ratelimit'; app.use(rateLimit<{ user: string | number }>({ maxRequests: 1, windowMs: 1000, keyGenerator: c => { c.set('user', 1); return 'key' } }))

name: case-preset-callback
source: import { rateLimiter } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/ratelimit'; app.use(rateLimiter.strict<{ user: string | number }>({ keyGenerator: c => { c.set('user', 1); return 'key' } }))

name: case-otel-callback
source: import { otelMiddleware } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/otel'; app.use(otelMiddleware<{ user: string | number }>({ spanNameResolver: c => { c.set('user', 1); return 'span' } }))

name: case-headers-callback
source: import { securityHeaders } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/security'; app.use(securityHeaders<{ user: string | number }>({ contentSecurityPolicy: c => { c.set('user', 1); return 'default-src none' } }))

name: case-token-callback
source: import { requireHeaderToken } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/security'; app.use(requireHeaderToken<{ user: string | number }>({ token: c => { c.set('user', 1); return 'token' } }))

name: case-key-value-correlation
source: new Photon<{ name: string; count: number }>().get('/', c => { const key = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'name' : 'count'; c.set(key, 'wrong'); return c.text('bad') })

name: case-context-writer
source: import type { GravitoContext } from '@gravito/photon'; const writer = (c: GravitoContext<{user:string|number}>) => { c.set('user',123) }; app.use(writer)
